name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
summary: Sha Tin university with eight faculties and a collegiate system; the stated IB minimum is 30 of 45 points.

ib.text: Minimum 30 of 45 points and IB English grade 4. IB Chinese grade 4 is asked unless the faculty Dean exempts you. The 2027 IB sheet lists subject preferences per programme, not requirements.

programmes.name: Medicine (MBChB)
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery
programmes.about: Six years in a personalised medical curriculum with mentoring, early clinical teaching and a choice of enrichment tracks; a one-year hospital internship in Hong Kong follows before you register as a doctor.
programmes.ib: Six IB subjects with three at HL, and Chemistry or Biology at HL (both recommended). After IB results, top-ranked applicants are interviewed in late July.

needs.note: Six subjects including three HL; taking both Biology and Chemistry is recommended

programmes.selectionNote: 30 is the university-wide IB minimum. The faculty ranks applicants on IB results and interviews the top-ranked after results are released.

flagshipSource.title: Medicine (MBChB): SMART personalised curriculum and CU Medicine Plus enrichment scheme (programme page)

programmes.name: Computer Science and Engineering
programmes.about: One department-based entry into the Department of Computer Science and Engineering; after year one you declare Computer Science (BSc, software and AI) or Computer Engineering (BEng, hardware and embedded systems).
programmes.ib: The IB sheet prefers Maths and one of Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science or Physics, preferably at HL; these are preferences, not requirements.
programmes.selectionNote: 30 is the university-wide IB minimum. Review is holistic: results, non-academic record and any interview.

flagshipSource.title: Computer Science and Engineering: Computer Science launched over 40 years ago; both majors HKIE-accredited

programmes.name: Integrated BBA Programme
programmes.about: A broad business degree where you build your own path from nine concentrations such as finance, marketing and business analytics, with exchange, mentoring and internship options and double-degree routes.
programmes.ib: No subject preference is listed for the IBBA itself; the IB sheet prefers Maths for its finance, actuarial and analytics majors.
programmes.selectionNote: 30 is the university-wide IB minimum. Review is holistic: results, non-academic record and any interview.

flagshipSource.title: Integrated BBA: a flagship business programme with nine concentration areas (programme page)

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: HL in the matching subject is preferred for Chinese, English, Fine Arts, Music and Translation; other majors name no subject.

faculties.name: Faculty of Business Administration
faculties.line: Maths is preferred for finance, actuarial and analytics majors; English A (or English B at HL) for the BBA and Juris Doctor double degree.

faculties.name: Faculty of Education
faculties.line: HL Chinese or English is preferred for the language-education degrees, and HL Maths for Mathematics Education.

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering
faculties.line: Maths plus a science is preferred, mostly at HL for AI, Computer Science and Engineering, and Computational Data Science.

faculties.name: Faculty of Law
faculties.line: The LLB prefers English A at SL or HL, or English B at HL; admission is holistic.

faculties.name: Faculty of Medicine
faculties.line: MBChB wants Chemistry or Biology at HL; Pharmacy prefers Chinese and HL Chemistry; Biomedical Sciences prefers a science or Maths.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Two of Maths, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Economics or Geography, preferably at HL, for the broad-based science entry.

faculties.name: Faculty of Social Science
faculties.line: Economics prefers Maths or Physics, Psychology prefers Maths, Architectural Studies prefers English; other majors name no subject.

notes: Hong Kong sets no EU rate: non-local tuition is HK$230,000 for 2027/28, and any yearly adjustment for the 2027 cohort is capped at 3%.
You submit one application; if you are not picked in the Advance Offer Round you compete on equal footing in the Regular Round.
CUHK describes itself as bilingual, so check the medium of instruction of the courses in your programme.
